# has partner

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPartner`](gmeow-hasPartner.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPartner>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/genealogy`](../../slices/genealogy.md)

Relates a couple relationship to one of its two partners.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CoupleRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-CoupleRelationship.md) -> [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md)
